meta_description:
131K likes, 574 comments - mythpat on October 8, 2026: "Made this 9 years ago when Natsamrat had released. When I heard Nana Patekar deliver these dialogues in the theatre i got Goosebumps! I recreated this in my college days and I Really wanted to show him
Got a chance to show him via a Friend and he said "Chaan Karto Porga" which means "The boy is doing good!"

His reply gives me a smile till date :) As a Maharashtrian I am Sooo proud of what he has done for Marathi Cinema and Bollywood. I Really wanted to meet him in person once :( R.I.P Nana Patekar".
